modules.title: Hook 怎样在文件写入后触发检查

items.title: 监听生命周期事件
items.text: Hook 可以绑定会话启动、文件写入后或命令执行前等时间点。

items.title: 自动运行预设任务
items.text: 事件发生后，工具执行配置好的格式化、检查或准备脚本。

items.title: 失败结果可以拦截流程
items.text: 像提交前测试这样的 Hook 可以用失败状态阻止后续动作，但每次写文件都跑重测试会拖慢流程。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Hook 是事件触发的自动动作；Skill 是被调用的任务方法；Plugin 是可分发的软件包。Hook 能格式化或检查代码，不能替你修复业务逻辑。

lessonPractice.title: 想在 AI 写完文件后自动格式化，哪种机制最合适？

options.label: 配置 post-write Hook，在文件写入事件后运行格式化命令
options.feedback: 对。Hook 由生命周期事件触发，适合在写入完成后自动执行预设任务。

options.label: 创建 Skill，让 Agent 每次自己判断是否要格式化
options.feedback: Skill 是可调用的任务方法，不是写入事件发生时自动触发的监听器。

options.label: 配置 Hook 后就能自动修复生成代码中的业务逻辑错误
options.feedback: Hook 只能运行预设脚本；格式化或检查不能替代业务逻辑修复和人工验收。

en.title: Which mechanism fits automatic formatting after the AI writes a file?

options.label: Configure a post-write Hook to run the formatter after the file-write event
options.feedback: Correct. Hooks are triggered by lifecycle events and run preset tasks after a write completes.

options.label: Create a Skill and let the agent decide whether to format each time
options.feedback: A Skill is an invokable task method, not a listener that automatically responds to a file-write event.

options.label: A Hook will automatically repair business logic bugs in generated code
options.feedback: A Hook only runs its preset script; formatting or checks do not replace logic fixes and review.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为 .ts 和 .tsx 文件配置写入后的格式检查 Hook。先说明它会在哪个事件触发、命令会改什么，再确保命令不会读取密钥或操作无关目录。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Configure a post-write formatting hook for .ts and .tsx files. Explain when it runs and what it changes, and make sure it cannot read secrets or touch unrelated directories.

learning.assumes: You know that scripts can run formatting, tests, or other checks locally.
learning.outcome: You can choose a Hook timing based on events and distinguish how Hooks, Skills, and Plugins are triggered.

modules.title: How does a Hook run a check after a file write?

items.title: Listen for lifecycle events
items.text: A Hook can attach to startup, after a file write, or before a command runs.

items.title: Run a preset task
items.text: When the event occurs, the tool runs the configured formatter, check, or setup script.

items.title: A failure can stop the next action
items.text: A pre-commit test hook can block a commit on failure, while running heavy tests after every write can slow the workflow.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A Hook is an event-triggered action, a Skill is an invoked task method, and a Plugin is a distributable package. A Hook can format or check code but cannot repair business logic.

distinctions.label: Plugin
distinctions.text: A {c:hook} executes automatically when a specific lifecycle event fires; a {c:plugin} is a broader module that packages new features or extensions for the host application.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: Show the Hooks this tool supports and explain their event triggers. If I configure a post-write Hook, make sure it only formats files and cannot run destructive scripts.
